children: Polystyrene maker Supreme Petrochem Ltd on Friday (October 23) reported a 97.9% year-on-year (YoY) increase in net profit to ₹95 crore for the September quarter, compared with ₹48 crore in the year-ago period.
Revenue rose 77.8% YoY to ₹1,956 crore from ₹1,100 crore.
The company declared an interim dividend of ₹2.50 per equity share, representing 125% of the face value of ₹2 per share, for the financial year 2026-27.
The interim dividend will entail an outgo of ₹47.01 crore. Supreme Petrochem has fixed Friday, October 30, 2026, as the record date to determine shareholders eligible to receive the dividend.
Shares of Supreme Petrochem Ltd ended at ₹710.10, down by ₹28.55, or 3.87%, on the BSE.

title: Supreme Petrochem Q2 Results: Net profit nearly doubles to ₹95 crore; declares ₹2.50 interim dividend
